title: WAL Record (Delta Atomicity)
description: Extracted from L1/CONTINUITY §4.1. Write-ahead log entry written + fsync'd BEFORE any DAG mutation. Per L0 §6.

envelope_canonical_bytes.description: Canonical-bytes serialization of the L1/SKIN §2 envelope.

payload_canonical_bytes.description: Canonical-bytes serialization of the delta payload.

claimed_dag_parents.description: Sporocarp IDs the delta claims as parents.

monotonic_clock_at_wal_append.description: Substrate-process monotonic clock at WAL append (event ordering authority per §1.5).

atomicity_protocol.step_1_wal_first: Append envelope + payload canonical-bytes to WAL with fsync BEFORE any DAG mutation.
atomicity_protocol.step_2_dag_transaction: Node creation + parent-edge insertion + tier-1 SSoT update = single in-memory transaction; all-or-nothing.
atomicity_protocol.step_3_cycle_commit: Cycle completion bumps DAG-tip atomically (single canonical-bytes write) AND fsyncs persisted DAG.
atomicity_protocol.step_4_crash_recovery: On restart, WAL replayed; entries past persisted DAG-tip rolled back.
